description: Modernise all page-level components (LoginPage, admin screens, teacher screens). This FEAT depends on FEAT-001 — the updated primitives must be in place first since these pages will switch from inline-dark raw elements to the light primitive components. Work covers: LoginPage (light card on gradient), AdminDashboard (stat grid colour fixes), AcademicMaster (tab bar + Modal create form), InstitutionSetup (primitive Input/Select/Button throughout), PeopleManager (search bar + striped table + primitive modals), AuditLogsViewer (Badge for actions + Modal detail view), QuestionBank (Badge difficulty tags + Modal create form), ExamBuilder (StatusBadge + Modal create form + Button actions), GradingQueue (Card panels + Input primitives), MarkEntryGrid (Modal create form + Button primitives + sticky table header).

findings: All 10 components modernised successfully. LoginPage: white card on indigo-50/slate-100 gradient, no dark surfaces. AdminDashboard: light stat cards, corrected text colours, light quick-action buttons. AcademicMaster: tab bar added (4 tabs), Add Subject modal uses Modal+Input primitives. InstitutionSetup: all raw inputs replaced with Input/Select primitives, Button primitive for submit. PeopleManager: search input added, tab bar changed to underline style, Button primitives, striped rows, form wraps both CardContent and CardFooter.
